description: Core skills for the Ascent Plan: unlock level, cooldown, role and Specialty perks, for the global (EU and NA) servers. A role (value, from, quote) is set only where the skill summary or the class build says it in those words; the quote is the exact text it rests on. No role means the data does not say.
